collectionStaleHint: CMDB collection has stopped; the node itself may be fine — check collection first

empty.filtered: No nodes match the current filters. Try widening them.
empty.noSource: No nodes collected yet. Check on the Clusters page that the cluster is onboarded and its credentials are valid.
empty.title: No nodes

impact.noDomains: No public domains found. Either these services are internal, or Ingress / VirtualService has not been collected yet — the drain risk differs completely between the two, so do not read this as "no impact".
impact.noPods: No pods collected on this node. It may genuinely be empty, or collection may not have run yet.
impact.title: What breaks if this node goes down

live.pickCluster: Select a single cluster — usage is queried from Prometheus per cluster

packing.limExtremeHint: Limits total {{pct}}% of node capacity — well beyond routine overcommit. Simultaneous peaks will contend heavily and throttling on this node is amplified
packing.limOverHint: Limits total more than 1.5× node capacity. Limits are ceilings, not reservations, so overcommit is normal — but containers will contend for CPU if they all peak together

staleNote_one: {{count}} nodes have untrustworthy status (heartbeat or collection stopped)
staleNote_other: {{count}} nodes have untrustworthy status (heartbeat or collection stopped)
title: Nodes
unlinkedHint: No matching machine in the host inventory. Usually a self-managed box that is not in the cloud inventory, or a node whose name and internal IP both differ from the instance.
usageUnavailable: Actual usage needs Prometheus (shown here is request/limit packing, not real usage)
